rationale: The HUD at line 6783 renders heliocentricKms.toFixed(2). heliocentricKms is the $derived at line 951 whose only call is flyHeliocentricSpeed(scR, isMoonMission ? R_EARTH_AU : (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU) / 2). For outer-planet missions scR reaches 5–30 AU while a is frozen at ~1.262 AU, so 2/r − 1/a < 0 and sqrt returns NaN. heliocentricSpeed() in fly-physics.ts is the textbook vis-viva and is correct; the bug is the hardcoded Earth-Mars transfer axis at the call site in the page, which must instead be derived from the actual mission's destination orbit.
